mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in non-farm payrolls and decrease in unemployment rate indicates a tightening labor market that accelerates consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts below the 12-month moving average signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with HOUST < 12mo MA during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and year-over-year CPI inflation indicates a monetary policy response to high inflation, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightening regime, a decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals strong labor demand that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
